infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EyeGo Driver uses your location while the app is open so you can go online, receive trip requests and navigate.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow location while EyeGo Driver is in the background so your passengers can keep seeing where you are during a trip, even with the app closed. This is only used while you are on a trip.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EyeGo Driver needs camera access to update your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EyeGo Driver needs photo library access to update your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow EyeGo to access your contacts to add an emergency contact.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow background location so your passengers can see where you are during a trip even with the app closed. Only used while you are on a trip.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow EyeGo Driver to access your photos to update your profile picture.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow EyeGo to access your contacts to add an emergency contact.
